RESOLUTION (Phase 050): one rule for every attempt. An attempt has a capability C (what the actor brings: force, technique, fit, team, conditions) and a demand D (what the thing asks: a container's toughness or lock strength, scaled by its condition). rho = C / D maps, with no randomness, to progress, stamina cost, strain, wear and noise. The pure function is worlds/resolution.py; this table holds its numbers.

REFERENCE POINT. An average adult (effective strength 1.0, body size 1.0, full reserve, health 1.0), at intensity 1.0, with technique 1.0 (skill 1.0), a tool that fits (fit 1.0), no team (neutral_team 1.0) and normal conditions (neutral_conditions 1.0), has C = 1.0. A demand of 1.0 is one such adult's push. Recipes (Phases 022 and 023) keep their own mechanism: their cost passes through cost_ratio with floor 1, and a worker who meets the strength gate has D/C at most 1, so the declared cost is paid as before.

VERBS are in the VERBS table of this file. MATERIALS gives each material's hardness, toughness, fragility and noise. Every number here is APPROX unless a source is given. The sources below are for the order of magnitude only.

HARDNESS. hardness is on a 0 to 1 scale: iron is about 4.5 on the Mohs scale (Mohs, 1822), and granite 6 to 7; the 0 to 1 scale is a linear rescale of the Mohs values by 1/10 (APPROX). Wood, cloth, leather and wax are not on the Mohs scale; their values are APPROX orders of magnitude.

RESOLUTION keys. attempt_cap_rate: the most progress one attempt can make, in multiples of the reference (2.0: an attempt can run at up to twice the reference, so force above the reference still shows as more damage). progress_exponent: progress = min(attempt_cap_rate, rho^progress_exponent). technique_floor: technique = technique_floor + (1 - technique_floor) x effective skill; an unskilled worker keeps half the technique. base_cost: stamina per attempt at rho = 1 (APPROX; 0.1 is a tenth of a unit of reserve, the scale of the Phase 022 recipe costs). floor and effort_cap: the bounds on the cost ratio clamp(D/C, floor, effort_cap); attempts use floor 0. k: the exponent of intensity on stamina (an attempt at twice the intensity costs more than twice as much when k > 1). i_safe and m: strain past the safe intensity is max(0, i - i_safe)^m, paid whether or not the attempt works. max_intensity: the clamp on the requested intensity (the reserve, exhaustion and health lower the ceiling further). unrelated_fit: the fit of a tool whose verb is not in a verb's tool_verbs. hands_fit: the fit with no tool (neutral 1.0; Phase 048 gives hands their own fit). neutral_team and neutral_conditions: 1.0 until Phases 047 (joint actions) and the conditions terms give them values. tool_wear: wear per attempt on a tool that fits, at intensity 1. mismatch_wear: how much more a tool wears when it does not fit (its wear is multiplied by 1 + mismatch_wear x (1 - fit)). hardness_wear: how much more it wears against a harder material (multiplied by 1 + hardness_wear x (target hardness - tool hardness)). damage_per_attempt: condition lost by a target in one attempt at progress 1 (scaled by the material's fragility as 0.5 + fragility). lock_material: the material a lock is taken to be made of for hardness and noise. default_material: the material taken for a container whose kind has no material in ITEMS. noise_base: loudness of one attempt at intensity 1 for a material noise factor of 1.0; it is a radius in cells (Phase 028). strain_limit: the strain at which the actor takes one accident harm, and the strain resets. accident_harm: the health lost at each accident (through harm(..., 'accident')).

PHASE 050b KEYS (all APPROX; model choices, not measured). haste_cap, care_cap: the pace of a recipe job (intensity on transform) is clamped to [1 / care_cap, haste_cap]; a faster job runs at up to haste_cap times the reference rate, a slower one at 1 / care_cap. haste_penalty: quality defect added per unit of pace above 1 (defect = 1 + haste_penalty x (pace - 1); below 1 the defect equals the pace). haste_yield_loss: output lost per unit of pace above 1. ruin_below: a batch the pace pushes below this quality is spoiled (its output is lost, its inputs are consumed); a batch already below it at pace 1 is not spoiled by the pace. trivial_below, slot_above: the cost share (stamina share, with intensity) below which an attempt is free of stamina, and below which it leaves the action slot unspent; the same values as CONTEST (Phase 029), which keeps its own copies. strain_sleep_recovery: strain a sleeping resident sheds per clock tick (a tick is 15 minutes, TIME.minutes_per_tick). push_mass_unit: the load (in ITEMS weight units; APPROX, the scale of the pack's item weights) that an average adult pushes at normal intensity over level ground, the demand of 1.0 for a displacement; push_cells_per_surplus and push_max_cells: a displacement moves floor(surplus x push_cells_per_surplus) cells, at most push_max_cells, where the surplus is capability minus demand. NOT IN THIS TABLE (later phases). Quality and yield curves for a recipe's inputs beyond the pace terms above, the escalation policy of the simple backend (cheap.py), throw and blows (Phase 038), and lift and carry (not implemented; see VERBS). test_hamlet: VERBS keeps the verbs the hamlet lexicon names (smash, hit, carry). Its skills are fighting and baking, so the force verb uses fighting, and carry uses no skill (skill null: the verb needs none).

smash.description: Break a thing by hard blows: a container's condition falls until it breaks.

hit.description: Strike a thing once or often with a held object. Damage primitive, as smash, with a blow's lower fit.

force.description: Break a lock by weight and blows.

carry.description: Carry a thing on the body. Displace primitive, not implemented yet, so refused as unsupported.
